intro: The Glyphic Letter is an official missive bearing the arcane sigil of Khelden Bremen, the resident mage trainer in Northshire Abbey. Delivered to promising novitiates after early service to the garrison, it bids aspiring mages to report upstairs and face the rigorous realities of arcane study.

p: Sealed with the personal insignia of the mage trainer Khelden Bremen, the Glyphic Letter is handed to apprentice spellcasters once they have proven their discipline in Northshire Valley. The letter acts as a formal invitation to step away from basic field duties and begin dedicated magical instruction within the abbey. Bremen uses the summons to gauge the student's resolve, ensuring anyone meddling with the arcane is fully prepared to confront dangerous forces, unyielding scrutiny, and the burdens that come with wielding raw magical power.
